means.idiom-jp: 〜をあきらめる；〜を捨てる［やめる］
means.example-sentence: Maggie is known for her strong will; she would not easily give up her dreams.
means.sentence-jp: マギーは強い意志で知られている。彼女は簡単に自分の夢をあきらめようとはしないだろう。

cloze.maskedText: Maggie is known for her strong will; she would not easily ____ her dreams.

notes: give up on 〜 の形もある。
